text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) study of dairy farming systems, not a review. It fails the core inclusion criteria: 1) It does not implement national-scale spatial LULC prediction; instead, it *uses* results from global economic models (GTAP, LEITAP) as inputs to estimate off-farm land use change impacts. 2) Its primary focus is on comparing the environmental impacts (climate change, land occupation) of two dairy systems, not on LULC prediction/simulation as a central research question. 3) It does not produce spatially explicit LULC maps or projections. The LULC change is treated as a calculated, non-spatial consequence derived from external models.)
